title: Location Metric1 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Photos (`photo:capture`), places visited (`location:visit`), voice memos (`voicememo:note`), logged moments (`lifelog:moment`), timeline events (`timeline:event`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — photo libraries (Google Photos, Immich), location history, voice memos, and daily-moment journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=location:metric1 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in location metric1 (1) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme location metric1 (1) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you the unusually high or low value moments in your location metric1 (1) history.
